raw_response:
Answer: C
Reason: Figure 1 shows diffuse bilateral alveolar opacities consistent with pulmonary edema (often seen in salt water aspiration), which have largely cleared in Figure 2; this rapid resolution is characteristic of supportive care (oxygen/ventilation) allowing reabsorption of edema fluid, whereas pneumonia or ARDS would typically resolve more slowly or require different specific interventions.
